name: Parabolic SAR
summary: This EA uses the Parabolic SAR indicator to identify trend direction and generate entry signals. It opens buy positions when SAR dots flip below price and sell positions when dots flip above price, riding trends until the SAR reverses. The strategy is a classic trend-following system that uses the built-in MT5 Parabolic SAR indicator for both entry and exit signals.
summary_zh: 该EA使用抛物线SAR指标识别趋势方向并生成入场信号。当SAR点翻转到价格下方时开多单，翻转到上方时开空单，跟随趋势直到SAR反转。这是一个经典的趋势跟踪系统，利用MT5内置的抛物线SAR指标同时作为入场和出场信号。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于抛物线SAR（Stop and Reverse）指标，这是一种经典的趋势跟踪工具。入场条件为：当SAR指标点从价格上方翻转到下方时产生买入信号，从下方翻转到上方时产生卖出信号，这代表趋势方向发生了转变。出场条件同样依赖SAR指标：当持仓方向与SAR信号相反时平仓，即SAR反转时既是旧仓位的出场也是新仓位的入场，形成Stop and Reverse机制。仓位管理方面，从参数命名来看使用固定手数（Lots参数），没有动态仓位调整或基于资金比例的下单逻辑。资金管理方面，该EA可能依赖SAR作为跟踪止损来实现风险控制，但若无独立的止损设置则风险较大。SAR的步长（Step）和最大值（Maximum）参数直接决定了指标的灵敏度，步长越大指标对价格变化越敏感，但也更容易产生虚假信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the Parabolic SAR (Stop and Reverse) indicator, a classic trend-following tool. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when SAR dots flip from above price to below, and a sell signal when they flip from below to above, indicating a trend direction change. Exit conditions also rely on the SAR indicator: positions are closed when the SAR signal reverses against the held position, meaning the SAR reversal serves as both the exit for the old position and entry for a new one, forming a Stop and Reverse mechanism. Position sizing typically uses a fixed lot size (Lots parameter), with no dynamic position adjustment or equity-proportional sizing logic. Money management relies on the SAR as a trailing stop mechanism for risk control, but without an independent stop loss the risk exposure could be significant. The SAR Step and Maximum parameters directly determine the indicator's sensitivity — a larger step makes the indicator more responsive to price changes but also increases the likelihood of false signals.

parameters.name: TakeProfit

parameters.description_en: EA magic number; 0 monitors all orders

parameters.name: Timeframe
parameters.description: 指标计算的时间周期，0为当前周期

pros: 策略逻辑清晰简洁，基于经典技术指标，易于理解和验证
Parabolic SAR天然具有跟踪止损功能，能锁定趋势利润
Stop and Reverse机制确保始终持仓，不会错过大趋势行情
参数少，优化空间有限但不易过度拟合
pros_en: Clear and concise strategy logic based on a well-established technical indicator, easy to understand and verify
Parabolic SAR inherently provides trailing stop functionality, effectively locking in trend profits
Stop and Reverse mechanism ensures always being in a position, never missing major trend moves
Few parameters mean limited optimization space and lower risk of overfitting
cons: 在震荡行情中SAR频繁反转会产生大量虚假信号和连续亏损
固定手数下单缺乏资金管理，无法根据账户规模动态调整风险
SAR指标滞后性明显，入场时趋势可能已经走了一段距离
若未设置独立止损，在突发事件中可能承受巨大亏损
cons_en: SAR frequently reverses in ranging markets, generating numerous false signals and consecutive losses
Fixed lot sizing lacks money management, unable to dynamically adjust risk based on account size
SAR indicator has notable lag, entering trends after they have already moved significantly
Without an independent stop loss, the EA may suffer massive losses during sudden market events
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如ADX或大周期均线），在震荡行情中抑制SAR的虚假信号
实现基于账户余额百分比的动态仓位管理，替代固定手数
加入ATR自适应止损，根据市场波动率调整止损距离
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., ADX or long-period moving average) to suppress SAR false signals during ranging markets
Implement dynamic position sizing based on account equity percentage instead of fixed lots
Add ATR-adaptive stop loss that adjusts stop distance based on market volatility

risk_points: 震荡行情中SAR频繁反转导致连续开平仓，累积点差和手续费损失
若未设置独立止损，趋势反转时亏损可能远超预期
固定手数不考虑账户规模，小账户可能过度杠杆
risk_points_en: Frequent SAR reversals in ranging markets cause consecutive open/close cycles, accumulating spread and commission losses
Without independent stop loss, losses during trend reversals may far exceed expectations
Fixed lot sizing ignores account size, potentially causing excessive leverage on small accounts
